title: Mold Remediation Tier Standards: Assessor Protocol and Clearance
content:
Each Mold Remediation tier fixes whether an independent assessor's written protocol must precede the work and how the finished work is cleared. The figures below are the tier values for every tier the company sells.

## Tier values

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent assessor's written protocol on file before signing | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Clearance method | Supervisor visual inspection | Independent assessor verification | Independent assessor verification | Independent assessor verification | Independent assessor verification | Independent assessor verification |
| Clearance test fee, first attempt (USD) | 0.00 | 425.00 | 495.00 | 645.00 | 525.00 | 575.00 |
| Retest after a failed clearance billable | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Re-cleaning after a failed clearance billable | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Maximum clearance attempts | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

## Meaning of each item

- **Protocol on file before signing**: whether a written remediation protocol from an independent mold assessor must be on file before the remediation agreement is signed.
- **Clearance method**: how clearance is established. Supervisor visual inspection is a post-remediation visual inspection by the company supervisor; independent assessor verification is a post-remediation verification by the independent assessor.
- **Clearance test fee**: the independent post-remediation verification fee passed through for the first clearance attempt.
- **Retest billable / re-cleaning billable**: whether a clearance retest, or the re-cleaning labor, materials and equipment, after a failed clearance are billable. Every tier carries No for both.
- **Maximum clearance attempts**: the number of clearance attempts after which a job that still fails is escalated to a human project manager.

## Reading the schedule

- Spot Mold Remediation is the only tier with No in the protocol row and the only tier cleared by supervisor visual inspection; its clearance test fee is 0.00.
- Limited Mold Remediation and Spot Mold Remediation allow 2 clearance attempts; Standard, Extensive, Attic and Crawlspace and HVAC System Mold Remediation allow 3.
- Example, hypothetical: a Standard Mold Remediation job's first clearance attempt passes through a test fee of 495.00; the same tier's retest after a failure is not billable, because its retest row reads No.
